note: The vector ROM of Asteroids rev 4 (035127-02, CPU $5000-$57FF = DVG word $800-$BFF). Addresses from sources/docs/disasm_notes.md 2.4 (VEC: labels of A35127.XX, verified in McFadden's listing).

roms.note: vector ROM: shapes, font, messages, sine

rocks.note: VEC:ROCKS — JSRL table to ROCK1..4; PICTUR: JSRL ROCKS[(OBJ & $18) >> 3]; global scale 0 / F / E for the large / medium / small rock

saucer.note: VEC:SAUCER — a JSRL to its own 10$; global scale F (large) / E (small)

ships.note: VEC:SHIPS — 17 pictures 0..90 degrees every 5.625 (index = angle/4 after folding), each 5 vectors + RTSL, then the flame (2 vectors + RTSL); the game copies the vectors into RAM with the sign bits of X and/or Y flipped (dis UpdateShipDraw $750b, DrawShip $6ad3); global scale E

livesIcon.note: VEC:SHIP17 — the ship of the reserve lives, nose up, intensity 7; the trailing dark VCTR 80,24 leaves the beam 64 to the right for the next icon; drawn at global scale E from (160, 852)

shipPieces.note: VEC:EXPSHP — the six pieces of the exploding ship, one SVEC each at intensity 12 (SHPEXP, notes 8)

explosions.note: VEC:EXPPIC — JSRL table to EXP10, EXP12, EXP14, EXP16: ten dots at intensity 7 in four sizes; PICTUR: EXPPIC[(OBJ & $0C) >> 2] at global scale (OBJ & $F0) + $10

copyright.note: VEC:ASTMSG rev 2/4 (dis VecCredits): LABS 400,128 scale 0, then the glyphs of '© 1979 ATARI INC' — a subroutine with its own position, so its segments are absolute

testPattern.note: VEC:TEST1 — the self-test frame 0..1023 x 128..895, the diagonals and the intensity wedge; absolute

font.note: VECAN CHAR.x through the JSRL table VGMSGA (dis CharPtrTbl $56D4): 37 glyphs, SVEC strokes on an 8 x 12 cell at global scale 0, every glyph leaves the beam 12 to the right; texts are drawn at scale $10 (x2: 16 x 24, advance 24), $00 and $20
